title: Enemies: Wisp, Brute, Mite
desc: Three original enemies (fear, rage, parasite), each playing idle, attack and death; J picked "enemy designs ... with idle, attack and death animations".

takes.name: Dread Wisp (fear)
takes.facts: six yellow eye-plates orbit; attack: eyes stare, fear cone washes the player, tendrils lash; death: eyes go out 3 ticks apart, unravels to dark pixels; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot

takes.name: Ember Brute (rage)
takes.facts: cracks pulse with the breath; attack: double-fist slam at 63, red ground ring to 6 blocks, player knocked back; death: staggers twice, bursts; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot

takes.name: Leech Mite (parasite)
takes.facts: skitters in a circle; attack: leaps onto the player's back, violet sac pulses while it drains; death: shaken off, curls, pops; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot
